redundancy_check.note: All final units were cross-checked for duplicate evaluation targets. Each unit covers distinct project updates, financial metrics, or market context without substantive overlap.

key_information_units.information: Q1 2025 revenue increased to EUR 1,706 thousand (72% YoY growth from EUR 990 thousand in Q1 2024), with operating profit of EUR 259 thousand (vs operating loss of EUR 208 thousand in Q1 2024) and net profit of EUR 103 thousand (vs net loss of EUR 349 thousand in Q1 2024).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report - Key Performance Indicators table and Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income

key_information_units.information: Net loans increased to EUR 15,455 thousand as of 31 March 2025, with the weighted average annual interest rate of interest-bearing liabilities decreasing to 8.2% (a reduction of 0.5 percentage points compared to 31 December 2024).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report - Key Performance Indicators section and Note 12 (Interest bearing liabilities)

key_information_units.information: Estonia’s real estate market showed credible signs of revitalization in Q1 2025, with increased transaction activity, stabilized price levels, and declining Euribor rates supporting consumer interest and transaction volumes.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report - Group CEO's Review (first paragraph)

key_information_units.information: In the Rannakalda development (Kodulahe), four additional apartments were sold in Q1 2025, bringing the total units sold to 91 out of 113 (21 units remaining vacant as of the report publication date).

The Soodi 6 project (Kodulahe VII etapp) has the detail plan issued, with 66 units (62 apartments and 4 commercial premises) planned; construction is expected to commence at the end of Q2 2025 and complete in 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report - Group CEO's Review and Arco Vara's Active Projects table

key_information_units.information: Arco Vara acquired a development site at Spordi 3a, 3b in Tallinn during Q1 2025; the project comprises 56 apartments (7,600 m² gross building area) with a total investment of EUR 15 million; pre-sales will begin in Q2 2025, and handover is scheduled for the end of 2026.

The Botanica Lozen project in Bulgaria reached 95% readiness for the first phase (16 houses) by the end of Q1 2025; nine of the 16 houses had been sold by quarter-end, with full completion expected by the end of Q2 2025.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report - Group CEO's Review and Operating report section

key_information_units.information: Preparatory work for the Arcojärve project is progressing according to plan; the detailed plan approval is targeted in the coming months, with construction scheduled to begin at the end of 2025.
Detailed planning for the Kodulahe development at Lammi 6 advanced significantly in Q1 2025; construction is anticipated to start in approximately two years from the report date.
The Merivälja Kuldlehe exclusive cluster house development comprises five apartments; two have been sold to date, with three remaining vacant as of 31 March 2025.
